in_marathi.name: Ronak
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joy, Pleasure, Delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ronak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ronak is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ronaka' which means to rejoice, to take pleasure in, to be joyful, and to be delighted. The name evokes a sense of happiness and sunshine.
